_: The worked examples of the assistant's Pine reference. Each is run through the member's own paste path when the reference is generated (assistantPineReference.test.js): one that does not run fully fails there, and is never shown to the assistant.

examples.title: A summary table in a corner of the chart
examples.shows: table.new once with var, its cells written on EVERY bar (nothing waits for the last bar), numbers formatted with str.tostring

examples.title: A text label on each bar where something happens
examples.shows: label.new inside an if, the text built with str.tostring

examples.title: Horizontal lines at levels that change over time
examples.shows: var handles, line.delete before line.new, values carried with var float and :=

examples.title: A shaded box over a range of bars
examples.shows: one box made once with var and MOVED on every bar with box.set_lefttop and box.set_rightbottom (never deleted and remade, never waiting for the last bar)

examples.title: Lines, a fill between them, markers, background and bar colours
examples.shows: plot, fill, plotshape, bgcolor and barcolor with a colour chosen per bar

examples.title: A calculation that needs a loop and a list
examples.shows: a for loop with +=, an array kept with var, array.push / array.shift / array.max

examples.title: Swing highs marked where they happened
examples.shows: ta.pivothigh is known `right` bars late, so the label is placed at bar_index - right

examples.title: A weekly value on a daily chart
examples.shows: request.security on the chart's own symbol with the weekly timeframe

examples.title: This stock against a benchmark
examples.shows: request.security on a benchmark symbol at the chart's own timeframe

examples.title: Several levels drawn from a list, with a label on each
examples.shows: array.from, for ... in, each level's price kept in an array, the lines and labels made once (kept in arrays) and MOVED on every bar with line.set_xy1, line.set_xy2 and label.set_xy, and one value from that array PLOTTED so the run owns the drawings

examples.title: Heikin Ashi candles
examples.shows: candles drawn from computed values with plotcandle; ALL THREE colours (color, wickcolor, bordercolor) are written, each a fixed colour chosen by ?:, which is the shape this engine draws as candles

examples.title: A moving average whose type is a setting
examples.shows: ta.* calls in the arms of a switch over an input.string: the chosen arm runs on every bar, so each call sees every bar (a block that skips bars and runs again, such as an if on a price condition, is refused)
